annotation.title_clean: К вопросу о формализации этики поведения коллаборативного робота
annotation.title_en: On the issue of formalization of collaborative robot ethical behavior
annotation.venue: Информационные и математические технологии в науке и управлении
annotation.summary_en: Russian journal article (abstract) on mechanisms enabling a collaborative robot to be a moral agent. It argues classical and non-classical logics cannot formalize ethics, proposes utilitarianism with hedonistic rules, uses cognitive maps, and states three principles of robot moral behavior focused on needs, perception and self/other distinction.
key_provisions_or_claims: Logical schemes and non-classical logics cannot fully formalize moral doctrines given inherent contradictions and incompleteness.
Moral systems should supply an explanatory component justifying agent behavior, not merely evaluate actions.
Proposes utilitarianism (Bentham, Mill) combined with hedonistic axiology as basis for robot ethics.
Robot behavior is determined by current needs and perception state.
Morality rests on 'self vs. other' matching of conspecifics.
